topics.title: The Digital Marketing Funnel (AIDA: Awareness, Interest, Desire, Action)
topics.objective: Map consumer touchpoints and choose targeted marketing channels for each funnel stage.
topics.example: Top of Funnel: Informational blog; Bottom of Funnel: Search intent ad with free trial CTA
topics.exercise: Map out a complete multi-channel customer acquisition funnel for a subscription SaaS product.

topics.title: Search Engine Optimization (On-Page, Technical & Keyword Research)
topics.objective: Identify high-intent search keywords, structure semantic headers, and optimize meta descriptions.
topics.example: Target primary keyword in H1, first 100 words, URL slug, and title tag (< 60 chars).
topics.exercise: Conduct keyword research for an eco-friendly apparel brand and optimize an e-commerce product page.

topics.title: Content Marketing & Lead Magnets
topics.objective: Produce high-value educational assets (whitepapers, templates, checklists) that capture qualified emails.
topics.example: Landing page conversion rate = (leads captured / visitors) * 100
topics.exercise: Design an authoritative lead magnet concept and write high-converting landing page copy.

topics.title: Paid Performance Advertising (PPC, CAC, LTV & ROAS)
topics.objective: Structure search and social ad campaigns, manage bidding strategies, and calculate Customer Acquisition Cost.
topics.example: ROAS = Revenue from Ad Campaign / Ad Spend; target ROAS > 3.0
topics.exercise: Draft an ad campaign budget plan estimating CPC, CTR, conversion rate, and target ROAS.

topics.title: Web Analytics, Attribution & A/B Testing
topics.objective: Track user events, establish multi-touch attribution, and evaluate split-test statistical significance.
topics.example: Control vs Variant: Measure conversion rate lift with 95% statistical confidence.
topics.exercise: Design an A/B test hypothesis for a checkout page CTA and outline the measurement metrics.
